# pheno-plugin

Plugin trait + global registry for the Phenotype fleet.

## Install

```toml
[dependencies]
pheno-plugin = "0.1"
```

## Public API

```rust
use pheno_plugin::{Plugin, PluginRegistry, PluginError};

// 1. Define a plugin
struct MyPlugin;
impl Plugin for MyPlugin {
    fn name(&self) -> &'static str { "my-plugin" }
    fn version(&self) -> &'static str { "0.1.0" }
}

// 2. Register globally
inventory::submit!(&MyPlugin as &dyn Plugin);

// 3. Look up
let registry = PluginRegistry::collect();
let plugin = registry.get("my-plugin").expect("registered");
assert_eq!(plugin.name(), "my-plugin");
```

## Error types

```rust
pub enum PluginError {
    NotFound(String),
    AlreadyRegistered(String),
    VersionMismatch { expected: String, got: String },
}
```

## Environment

None. Pure library, no globals outside the `inventory!()` registration.

## Common errors

| Error | Cause | Fix |
|-------|-------|-----|
| `NotFound("my-plugin")` | Plugin wasn't submitted via `inventory::submit!` | Add the `submit!` in the plugin's `lib.rs` |
| `AlreadyRegistered("my-plugin")` | Two plugins with the same name | Rename one; names must be unique globally |
| Linker error for `inventory_iter` | Missing `inventory` dep in main crate | Add `inventory = "0.3"` to `[dependencies]` |

## Scope-out

- NOT a service mesh or RPC framework. Use `pheno-axum-stack` for HTTP.
- NOT a DI container. Use `pheno-di` (when it exists) for that.
- NOT a config loader. Use `pheno-config` for config.

## Tests

`cargo test` — 4/4 unit + 1 doctest = 5/5
